principle: 6 official CSOAI badges. Any HF model with a greenfield on any axis qualifies.

badges.name: CSOAI 22-axis measured
badges.criteria: Model scored on all 22 axes with valid signatures

badges.name: CSOAI card validated
badges.criteria: Model has a valid 3KB signed card on the chain

badges.name: CSOAI OTS-anchored
badges.criteria: Model card is Bitcoin-anchored via OTS

badges.name: CSOAI EAS-anchored
badges.criteria: Model card is EAS-attested on Base

badges.name: CSOAI 23/33 BFT attested
badges.criteria: Attested by 23 of 33 sovereign council agents

greenfields.doctrine: every model gets measured. no model escapes measurement.
